**solar2d-mcp can now update itself.**

- **Update notice:** about once a day it checks for a new release. If there is one, `status` and `run_project` say so, so your agent can tell you.
- **One command to update:** `solar2d-mcp.exe --update`. It works while Codex is open; the new version starts next time Codex launches the server.
- **Signed updates:** every release is signed, and the exe refuses anything without a valid signature, a matching checksum and a newer version number. Nothing is ever installed unless you run `--update` yourself.
- **Opt-out:** set `SOLAR2D_MCP_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to turn the daily check off. The check only downloads a small file from this repo's releases and sends nothing about you or your projects.
- **Company networks:** uses the Windows certificate store and your Windows proxy setting.

**Updating from v0.1.0** (needed once, since v0.1.0 has no updater). Close Codex, then:

```
curl.exe -L -o C:\Tools\solar2d-mcp\solar2d-mcp.exe https://github.com/JeremyWhale/solar2d-mcp/releases/latest/download/solar2d-mcp.exe
```

(Use the folder you put it in.) From here on, `--update` does it for you.

**New install:** download `solar2d-mcp.exe`, put it somewhere like `C:\Tools\solar2d-mcp\`, then run `codex mcp add solar2d -- C:\Tools\solar2d-mcp\solar2d-mcp.exe`.

Tested under Wine on Linux against Solar2D 2026.3729; it hasn't been run on real Windows yet, so please report anything odd.
